name: M7.FactorReplay.pool_complete
statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M7.FactorReplay.BP), p ∈ M7.FactorReplay.pool n ↔ p.natDegree ≤ n
guidance: Unfold actual pool and Finset.mem_image. Forward use Polynomial.ofFn_natDegree_lt (show 1≤n+1 by omega). Backward choose Polynomial.toFn (n+1) p and Polynomial.ofFn_comp_toFn_eq_id_of_natDegree_lt using p.natDegree<n+1. This is complete explicit coefficient-vector enumeration, not assumed finite factor coverage. Return tactic lines without leading by.
